settings.title: Delivery & Ordering
settings.content:
Every quotation shows a delivery date for your destination and the shipping terms (DDP, CIF or EXW). The date is confirmed on the order acknowledgement.

Ready stock offers are held locally in Oman. Other products are ordered for you, and their lead time is confirmed with your quotation.

Each delivery comes with a packing list that matches your quotation line by line. Please report any damage or shortage within 48 hours. See our shipping policy for details.

settings.title: Need help finding the right reference?
settings.subtitle: Send us your product list or requirements and our team will assist you.
